name: a-vague-requirement
description: Vague requirement -> exploration + prioritized round with recommended answers, no code
turns: Quiero que los clientes puedan dejar reseñas de los productos en la tienda.

graders.name: round-quality
graders.criteria: PASS if ALL hold: (1) the reply asks the user a round of numbered questions (between 2 and 6); (2) every question comes with a recommended or suggested answer; (3) the most fundamental questions (goal/scope, who can review, moderation) come before details; (4) it does not claim to have implemented or written code. FAIL if any of these is missing, or if it starts implementing without asking.
